description: Create an empty Insights report, owned by you. Add widgets afterwards with anyforge_update_report. Requires `write` scope and a role that edits reports. Only call when the person asked for this report. Each report carries `url`, its Console page; when you show a report to the user, render its title as a link to that url.

datesShown.description: Which dates program widgets show: forecast (default), or plan (committed dates only, also on the share link).

title.description: The report title (1-120 characters). Default "Untitled report".

name: anyforge_create_report
title: Create report
